title: Versioning
shortDescription: Managing bucket versioning settings, checking the current status, enabling and suspending versioning, viewing metadata of all versions
metaDescription: All available methods for working with versioning in VK Object Storage buckets: Set versioning in a bucket (PutBucketVersioning), check the versioning configuration of a bucket (GetBucketVersioning), get metadata about all versions of objects in a bucket (ListObjectVersions)
